dedupe_keys.name: multi lidar observations of vestas multi rotor turbine wake

description: Vasiljević, Nikola and colleagues publish this resource through Zenodo. The completed Vestas/Riso multi-rotor evaluation uses dual-Doppler measurements with a fifteen-metre mast and a profiling instrument. The source describes approximately three months of measurements during August–November 2018. The case supports examination of multi-rotor wake behaviour and comparison with model expectations. The date range and approximate duration are preserved as stated. It does not establish a universal multi-rotor wake law or openly downloadable values for every observing device. Coverage is limited to the stated models, observations and application settings. Native metadata gives open access and the licence label cc-by-nc-sa-4.0. These terms describe the deposit; software and companion-data terms are distinguished where separately established. Only descriptive metadata and file descriptors were inspected; linked data, code and document bodies were not opened.
